name: shh-links
title: Shh Links
description: Paste links into Discord as [site](<url>), [text](<url>) or <url>, so Discord shows no preview embed.
author: xpectrum

commands.name: paste-link
commands.title: Paste Link Without Embed
commands.subtitle: Discord
commands.description: Check the text (the site's name, or what you selected in Discord) and the URL taken from the clipboard, then paste the link into Discord without sending it.

commands.name: paste-clipboard
commands.title: Paste Clipboard Without Embed
commands.subtitle: Discord
commands.description: Paste the links on the clipboard into Discord as [site](<url>), with no form. Words selected in Discord become the link text.

preferences.name: untrack
preferences.title: Links
preferences.label: Remove tracking parameters
preferences.description: Drop utm_*, fbclid, gclid and similar parameters from the pasted links.
